decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's core recycling-system know-how and already shows a strong customer value case, though there is some risk it is consolidated into the broader modular plant line.

As a mobile slow-speed shredder close to the established offer, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and its continued dedicated presentation suggests it remains commercially and technically supportable.
This flagship modular plant line is highly related to existing capabilities and is backed by quantified customer savings and a named reference case, making withdrawal very unlikely.

The new slow-speed shredder line is very close to the firm's existing competence base, so with its in-house R&D and industry-specific learning capacity the firm is more likely to refine than abandon it.

Although newer and with less visible market evidence so far, the mobile spiral shaft screens still build on the firm's established screening and material-processing knowledge, which favors retention and improvement.
